text:
maya: quick ping — opened PR #4281 to add an on-prem egress toggle and adjust auth header handling. need sec + privacy eyes before i merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4281

maya: summary: add env flag REDWOOD_ONPREM_ALLOW_EGRESS (default false), small change to proxy layer to skip outbound calls when disabled, and a canary rollout in deploy manifest. also added unit + integration tests.

maya: code snippet:
```
# default in manifest
env:
  - name: REDWOOD_ONPREM_ALLOW_EGRESS
    value: "false"
```

sam: thanks — can you confirm: 1) no secrets are being written to external endpoints, 2) KMS never leaves the VPC, 3) telemetry events when egress is allowed are limited and documented? also drop the egress decision into a single helper so it's auditable.

maya: yes on 1/2. telemetry will still emit a small event when outbound attempted (for debugging) but payload is just event type + code path, no request bodies. helper added at `pkg/onprem/egress.go`.

jess: privacy quick Q — where are those telemetry events stored and for how long? if anything includes filenames or user identifiers we need to mask.

maya: they go to our internal events topic (kinesis-internal) with 30d retention. events are `{event: "egress_attempt", path: "proxy", allowed: bool}`. no filenames/ids. i can add explicit redaction if you want.

jess: OK — please add a note in PR about retention and schema, + a test to assert we never attach request bodies. otherwise fine from privacy.

ow: (owen): infra check — can we canary this with 5% traffic in staging and then 10% in prod? also need a migration window for customers that rely on outbound callbacks.

maya: good call. i've added a rollout strategy in the kustomize overlay: `canary: 5->25 over 2 days`, and a README section for operators explaining the migration steps and how to opt back in per-tenant.

sam: security checklist: - config default deny (done), - helper centralized (done), - unit tests for disabled path (please add), - audit log entry when egress decision is made (prefer event id + reason).

maya: adding unit test now, and will emit an audit entry id for each decision. PR updated.

deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit: 162, integration: 14).

sam: nice. can we hold merge until 2 signoffs (sec + privacy) and a quick infra nod? + prefer merge during next deploy window (tomorrow 18:00 UTC).

jess: lgtm for privacy after the comment/doc change.

ow: lgtm from infra, please add a smoke run on canary before 10% bump.

maya: thanks all — i will add the doc, run the smoke in staging tonight, and target merge tomorrow 18:00 UTC if no issues. will post follow-up once merged. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — leaving a small follow-up: after merge, add a dashboard to track `egress_attempt` rate by tenant for first 72h.

maya: on it, will create a dash and share link in this thread after merge.

maya: tagging for final checklist: @sam @jess @owen — please confirm one last time before the window.

sam: confirmed. jess: confirmed. owen: confirmed.

maya: merging in window unless anyone objects. :rocket:
